replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,
Since there is only one recorded instance on your profile where you shared the same IP as the account banned for hacking, I can conclude that the account doesn't belong to you. However, what bothers me is the fact that you admitted to ban evading when you said you bought a new account in order to play on Avicus after your main account was banned. I understand that your decision did have some reason to it, as apparently you didn't know that ban evading was punishable and you were banned falsely. Regardless, you still broke the server's rules, and it is your responsibility to familiarize yourself with them when you first join the server; they are easily accessible in-game or on the forums. Considering your situation, I will appeal your permanent ban, but give both of your accounts 3-week temporary bans from the server.

I'll leave the appeal open for 24 hours if you'd like to respond.

Thanks,
rinn
